test: Targeted T-Mobile LTE UTC attempt on original ESP32
board: ESP32-D0WD-V3 revision 3.1; onboard antenna only; CPU 240 MHz; crystal 40 MHz
scope: Isolated diagnostic copy, two known carrier/PCI profiles. This was not a blind automatic-carrier-selection test and did not qualify T-Mobile UTC support.
probe_modifications: Print freshly decoded SIB1 bytes and diagnostic fields after onboard CRC gates
End a diagnostic trial after an UnsupportedCell outcome, including a received schedule with no SIB8
pc_role: Firmware upload, reset and read-only diagnostic observation; independent ASN.1 interpretation of printed SIB1 payload. No host time, RF samples or decoded time supplied to the board.

fresh_sib1_messages.onboard_crc_gates: RF readSystem returned Result::Ok (SI-RNTI CRC16 and transport CRC24) before SIB1 was parsed/emitted
fresh_sib1_messages.independent_asn1_decoder: pycrate 0.8.1 via tests/reference/lte_downlink.py; payload-level identity/schedule verification, not an independent raw-RF CRC check
